description.zh: 短版命名空间ID，不需要带上region，推荐。
description.en: The ID of the namespace. The region ID is not included. We recommend that you use this parameter.

description.zh: 长版命名空间ID。如果设置了该参数会继续生效而忽略NameSpaceShortId，该参数是为了兼容保留，推荐使用短版命名空间ID，简化参数。
description.en: The ID of the namespace. The format is `Region ID:Namespace name`. This parameter is retained for backward compatibility. If you specify this parameter, `NameSpaceShortId` is ignored. We recommend that you use `NameSpaceShortId` to simplify the request.

title.zh: 查询命名空间内的资源信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sae describe-namespace-resources --namespace-id cn-shanghai:test --name-space-short-id test --region cn-hangzhou
